passive.name: Doom 'n Gloom
passive.desc: Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.

spells.name: Mistral Bolt
spells.desc: Launch a damaging missile that accelerates mid-flight.

spells.name: Personal Space
spells.desc: Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.

spells.name: Looming Darkness
spells.desc: Summon a damaging and slowing zone that applies Gloom to enemies.

spells.name: Shadow Surge
spells.desc: Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion.  Recast to dash to them and deal damage.
